name: RELAY
tagline: Your job search should remember what you've done.
summary: SyberLabs' job-search product: a private review workspace that remembers the roles you researched, the drafts you accepted, and the interviews you started. Assistants help you write; Relay keeps the record.
capabilities: One history per job: matching posting URLs join the same record, and earlier research stays visible.
Exact draft acceptance: you approve specific wording; changing it requires review again.
Interview notes and follow-ups that do not reset a submitted or live-loop application.
Import a tracker CSV through column mapping and a record preview. Imported statuses stay research; existing Relay status and accepted drafts are preserved.
A verified fact ledger and learned style rules that gate agent drafts at the API. Unsupported claims are refused, not queued.
Batch review of logged drafts. Staging a draft does not accept it or send an application.
Choose between real postings to set preferences, then plan the week to maximise the expected value of the best single offer.
Pull public Greenhouse and Lever boards onto existing job identity. Discovery arrives Held.
Record outcomes with a receipt before a submission counts toward reply rates. Ended applications cannot be reopened by import.

integrations.name: ChatGPT
integrations.description: Prepare a job packet and prompt, then bring a JSON draft back for review.

integrations.name: Codex
integrations.description: The same packet, plus optional local drafting through the signed-in Codex CLI.

integrations.name: Obsidian
integrations.description: Selected research notes, version-bound draft edits, and job-context exports from your vault.

integrations.name: Notion
integrations.description: Read-only research import through a local command you run with your own credentials.

integrations.name: Claude
integrations.description: Draft preparation from your verified facts through the Claude API, using your own key.

integrations.name: Grok Bot
integrations.description: Validated research and draft file exchange inside the Bot's VM.

integrations.name: Tracker CSV
integrations.description: Map columns, preview rows, and import a local tracker file as research.

integrations.name: Greenhouse
integrations.description: Read-only public board pull onto existing job identity. No credentials and no application sending.

integrations.name: Lever
integrations.description: Read-only public board pull onto existing job identity. No credentials and no application sending.

boundary: You stay in control. Integrations are explicit file and command handoffs. Every returned draft needs human review. Agents cannot accept a draft or submit an application. Public board pulls are read-only. Relay does not send applications or sync accounts in the background.
openaiBoundary: ChatGPT uses a prompt and file handoff; Codex also supports a local CLI adapter. This release does not include a hosted ChatGPT app or MCP connection.
